payload.name: pc-classify-value
payload.description: Classify an optional raw value while preserving the distinction between missing and null. Reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('value') so absence and explicit null remain distinct. Returns {state:'missing',value:null} when the key is absent, {state:'null',value:null} when the value is an explicit null, {state:'value',value:original} when the value is an exact integer in 0..10 inclusive (booleans and floats are rejected), and {state:'invalid',value:null} for any other value. No defaults, coercion, exceptions, imports, host calls or I/O. This is an unapproved target-interface draft; Q1, human Q2 and host execution are still required.
